modalities.evidence: T 1 -weighted and T 2 -weighted structural MRI images

output.population: 23 healthy adults (11 females, 12 males, age = 20 to 69 years), age- and sex-balanced across five age strata from 20-29 to 60-69 years
output.summary: Defaced T1- and T2-weighted structural brain MRI from healthy adults scanned twice, on a 3T high-field scanner and a 64 mT ultra-low-field scanner, to assess test-retest reliability and high-field correspondence.
